profile.summary: Western Roofing Service is the trade name of Roofing Constructors, Inc, a roofing contractor based in San Leandro, California. It was founded in 1952 and does repair, re-roofing and new roofing, plus waterproofing, mostly on commercial, industrial and institutional buildings in Northern and Central California.
